create_marker_spheres: create multiple sphere markers at initial positions using the Marker class for pybullet visualization
update_marker_positions: update the positions of existing sphere markers by calling set_state with a list of xyz coordinates
create_object_marker: create a single visual marker of any pybullet shape type using the ObjectMarker base class
create_cuboid_marker: create a cuboid visualization marker with custom side lengths using the CuboidMarker class
create_cube_marker: create a cube visualization marker with equal side lengths using the CubeMarker class
